scientific_question: Can one fixed post-separation Bass-only dynamics transformation materially restore original Bass-event observability to the unchanged JGA frontend while preserving recovered-event timing?

read_only_characterization.method: Per-channel decode to float64; mono arithmetic mean for descriptive sample magnitudes; non-overlapping 1024-sample mono RMS frames; no filtering, detection, JGA, or parameter search.
read_only_characterization.interpretation: The frozen separated Bass contains a substantially larger low-level frame population, so a single memoryless upward-dynamics condition remains a plausible test of attenuated residual event observability. This does not establish event identity or causal mechanism.

single_processing_condition.input: Exact checksum-bound htdemucs_ft bass.wav independently for each frozen identical Phase-2 run
single_processing_condition.sample_transfer: For a=abs(x): y=0 when a=0; y=sign(x)*T*(a/T)**(1/2) when 0<a<T; y=x when a>=T.
single_processing_condition.channel_rule: Apply independently to every channel with no channel mixing.
single_processing_condition.time_behavior: MEMORYLESS_SAMPLE_SYNCHRONOUS; no attack, release, lookahead, delay, or temporal shift.
single_processing_condition.output: Stereo 44,100 Hz IEEE float32 WAV, 10,944,947 frames, scope [0,10944947), no dither.
single_processing_condition.peak_rule: Samples at or above threshold are unchanged; peak cannot increase; clipping is prohibited.

future_execution.drums_control: Use the identical frozen htdemucs_ft drums.wav without processing.
future_execution.jga: Unchanged JGA v0.3.0-alpha after processed outputs are frozen.
future_execution.scoring: Reuse exactly the frozen CED-VAL-006 Level-1, Level-2 original-EME Voronoi assignment, AD-038, and AD-040 scoring infrastructure.

decision_criteria.priority: Event-population recovery first; timing preservation independently mandatory; no weighted composite score.
decision_criteria.CLEAR_DYNAMICS_IMPROVEMENT: Both processed runs must exceed unprocessed htdemucs_ft for matched (>619), recall (>0.5867298578199052), F1 (>0.7278071722516166), and original-only (<436), while median absolute displacement, RMSE, and maximum absolute displacement are each no worse than the frozen unprocessed values; Drum control and AD-038/AD-040 statuses must not materially collapse.
decision_criteria.POPULATION_IMPROVEMENT_WITH_TIMING_DEGRA: Both runs improve the complete population tuple but fail at least one mandatory frozen timing-preservation bound.
decision_criteria.NO_MATERIAL_RESTORATION: Both runs fail to improve the complete population tuple over unprocessed htdemucs_ft.
decision_criteria.INDETERMINATE: Transformation, JGA, or scoring replay disagreement, authority failure, or discordant run categories prevents interpretation.
decision_criteria.baseline_context: Report independently whether both processed runs also exceed the frozen stochastic baseline-best tuple: matched >625, recall >0.5924170616113744, F1 >0.7212925562608193, original-only <430.
